blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Macromolecular pool fraction (MPF) is a quantitative imaging biomarker sensitive to myelin integrity and other changes in tissue macromolecular content, but specialized acquisitions and reconstruction methods limit its use in large-scale studies. We present a physics-guided, self-supervised deep learning framework for retrospectively estimating MPF directly from conventional clinical brain MRI ($T_1$-weighted, $T_2$-weighted, and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery [FLAIR]) without paired quantitative reference scans. The framework embeds an analytical two-pool magnetization transfer signal model that related sequence-averaged radiofrequency transmit power to apparent longitudinal relaxation. To accommodate heterogeneous clinical protocols, the network conditions intermediate features on acquisition parameters via adaptive instance normalization. It was trained and evaluated on a multisite, multivendor, multiprotocol dataset of 7,705 MRI sessions (3 T). Across 1,237 test sessions, mean MPF was $0.182 \pm 0.007$ in white matter and $0.144 \pm 0.009$ in gray matter, with limited variation across vendor-by-protocol groups (between-group coefficient of variation: 2.65% and 5.63%, respectively). In 70 sessions with demyelinating-disease labels, MPF was 35.6% lower in segmented lesions than in normal-appearing white matter. MPF maps from two different clinical protocols acquired in a healthy volunteer showed a mean voxel-wise absolute percentage difference of 7.7% and a concordance correlation coefficient of $0.888$, indicating good cross-protocol consistency. These results suggest that magnetization transfer-informed self-supervised learning enables stable MPF mapping from conventional clinical MRI, providing a scalable approach to investigate demyelinating pathology in both existing imaging archives and prospectively acquired conventional clinical scans without dedicated qMT acquisitions.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provides excellent soft-tissue contrast and is routinely used for clinical diagnosis. Signal intensity in conventional MR images depends on tissue properties such as longitudinal and transverse relaxation times ( T 1 T_{1} , T 2 T_{2} , T 2 ∗ T_{2}^{*} ) and proton-density (PD). In addition, magnetization transfer (MT) is a fundamental tissue- and sequence-dependent effect that influences the MR signal [ 1 ] . MT is commonly described using a two-pool model comprising a free-water pool and a semisolid pool [ 2 ] . The semisolid pool contains protons bound to macromolecules, including proteins and lipids, and has a transverse relaxation time on the order of microseconds. It is therefore not directly observable with conventional MRI. However, exchange of longitudinal magnetization between the free and semisolid pools alters the longitudinal relaxation of the observable free-water signal and produces biexponential relaxation. MT is consequently a major contributor to longitudinal relaxation in biological tissue [ 3 ] . The relative size of the semisolid pool is quantified by the macromolecular pool fraction (MPF, denoted m 0 s m_{0}^{\mathrm{s}} ), which quantifies the relative amount of protons bound to biological macromolecules that exchange magnetization with water protons [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 磁共振成像(MRI)提供了极佳的软质对比,并经常用于临床诊断. 传统MR图像中的信号强度取决于组织属性,如纵向和横向放松时间(T1 T_{1},T2 T_{2},T2 * T_{2}^{*})和质子密度(PD). 此外,磁化转移(MT)是影响MR信号[1]的基本组织和序列依赖效应. MT通常使用由自由水池和半固体水池组成的双池模型来描述. [2]. 半固态池中含有与大分子结合的质子,包括蛋白质和脂质,在微秒的顺序上具有反向放松时间. 因此,它不能直接观察到常规核磁共振。 然而,自由池和半固体池之间的纵向磁化交流改变了可观测的自由水信号的纵向松动,并产生了双向松动。 因此,MT是生物组织纵向放松的主要原因。 半固态池的相对大小通过宏分子池分数(MPF,表示m 0 s m_{0 s 0 }^{\-mathrm{s}})量化,它量化了与生物大分子结合的质子的相对数量,这些质子与水质子交换磁化[4].

blocks.en: Among quantitative MT tissue parameters, MPF has attracted particular interest as a marker of myelin integrity in multiple sclerosis (MS), the most common demyelinating disease of the central nervous system [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . MPF is sensitive to myelin content and is markedly reduced in MS lesions [ 6 , 3 , 4 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . This sensitivity has enabled investigations of spatial heterogeneity in demyelination and of lesion evolution over time [ 4 , 11 , 9 , 12 , 13 ] . Moreover, post-mortem studies associated reduced MPF with histopathological evidence of demyelination [ 4 , 14 , 15 ] . MPF mapping could therefore provide a quantitative imaging readout for studying demyelinating pathology, monitoring disease progression, and assessing treatment response.
blocks.zh: 在定量MT组织参数中,MPF在多发性硬化症(MS)中作为蛋白质完整性的标志,引起了特别的兴趣,这是中枢神经系统最常见的脱菌病[5,6,7]. MPF对myelin内容敏感,在MS损伤中明显减少[6,3,4,8,9,10]. 这种敏感性使得人们能够对解密过程中的空间异质性以及随时间推移而演变的损伤进行调查[4、11、9、12、13]。 此外,与尸检有关的研究还减少了MPF与解密的病理学证据[4、14、15]。 因此,MPF绘图可以提供定量成像读数,用于研究除虫病理学、监测疾病进展和评估治疗反应。

blocks.en: Despite this clinical potential, MPF mapping requires dedicated prospective quantitative MT (qMT) acquisitions with specialized pulse sequences and reconstruction pipelines that are generally not included in standard neuroimaging protocols. Several qMT methods have been developed over the past three decades, including multi-point off-resonance Z-spectroscopy [ 2 , 7 , 10 ] , rapid single-point mapping [ 16 , 17 ] , on-resonance selective inversion recovery [ 18 , 19 ] , steady-state saturation [ 20 ] , and transient hybrid-state methods [ 21 , 3 , 22 ] . These approaches require additional acquisition time and can only be applied prospectively. In addition, they cannot recover MPF from the large collections of conventional scans that already exist in clinical archives. These limitations restrict access to MPF maps and impede both large-scale biomarker studies and subsequent clinical translation.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这种临床潜力,但MPF映射需要专用的预期定量MT(qMT)收购,并配有专业的脉冲序列和重建管道,通常不包含在标准的神经成像协议中. 在过去30年中开发了几种qMT方法,包括多点离共振Z光谱[2,7,10],快速单点绘图[16,17],对共振选择性反演恢复[18,19],稳态饱和[20],以及瞬态混合态方法[21,3,22]. 这些办法需要更多的购置时间,而且只能在今后加以应用。 此外,它们无法从临床档案中已经存在的大量常规扫描中恢复MPF. 这些限制限制了MPF地图的获取,并阻碍了大规模的生物标记器研究和随后的临床翻译.

blocks.en: The widespread availability of routine clinical MRI provides an opportunity to derive quantitative tissue parameters without dedicated prospective acquisitions. Initial efforts to exploit these routine scans have relied on mathematical combinations of conventional contrasts—such as T 1 ​ w / T 2 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w}/T_{2}\mathrm{w} and T 1 ​ w / FLAIR T_{1}\mathrm{w}/\mathrm{FLAIR} ratios or empirical polynomial fits—as accessible proxies for myelin integrity and myelin water fraction (MWF) [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] . However, these approaches provide relative, intensity-based indices rather than quantitative physical parameters.
blocks.zh: 常规临床核磁共振的广泛提供,为在不专门进行预期获取的情况下得出定量组织参数提供了机会。 利用这些常规扫描的初步努力依赖于传统对比的数学组合——例如T 1 w / T 2 w / T → 1 + mathrm{w}/ T → 2 → mathrm{w}和T 1 w / FLAIR T → 1 + mathrm{w}/\ mathrm{FLAIR} 比率或经验性多名性配比——作为迈林完整性和迈林水分的可用代词[23、24、25]。 然而,这些方法提供了相对的、基于强度的指数,而不是数量物理参数。

blocks.en: More recently, self-supervised, physics-guided deep learning frameworks have begun to address these limitations by retrospectively estimating quantitative maps from routine multi-contrast acquisitions ( T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} , T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} , and FLAIR) without requiring paired reference scans [ 26 , 27 , 28 ] . These frameworks embed analytical Bloch equations-based signal models directly into the training objective, enabling scalable deployment across clinical archives. Existing frameworks, however, assume single-pool relaxation and remain restricted to relaxometry parameters ( T 1 T_{1} and T 2 T_{2} ) alongside PD. Consequently, the retrospective estimation of quantitative MT parameters, including the MPF, from conventional clinical MRI remains unexplored.
blocks.zh: 最近,自我监督、物理指导的深层学习框架已开始通过追溯性地估计常规多相冲突获取的定量地图(T 1 w T_{1}\ mathrm{w},T 2 w2_{ mathrm{w}和FLAIR)来解决这些局限性,而不需要对参考扫描[26, 27, 28]. 这些框架将基于Bloch方程的分析信号模型直接嵌入到培训目标中,从而能够在整个临床档案中进行可扩展的部署。 然而,现有的框架假设单一集合放松,并仍然限于与PD并列的放松度参数(T 1 T_{1}和T 2 T_{2}). 因此,从常规临床核磁共振对包括多氯二苯并呋喃在内的MT参数的追溯性估计仍未加以探讨。

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce a framework for estimating an MT-model-based MPF directly from routine T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} , T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} , and FLAIR images without paired qMT reference data. We extended a physics-guided, self-supervised deep learning framework by incorporating a simplified closed-form description of MT into its forward signal model. Following Teixeira et al. [ 29 ] , the model relates the MT-induced apparent longitudinal relaxation time to the tissue-dependent MPF and the average RF transmit power, B 1 , rms B_{1,\mathrm{rms}} , the latter being determined by the acquisition protocol. To reduce protocol-dependent variation in these estimated maps, we conditioned the network on the input scans’ acquisition parameters. We trained and evaluated the framework using a clinically heterogeneous, multicenter, multivendor dataset comprising more than 7,700 MRI sessions (23,000+ image volumes), including sessions from patients with demyelinating lesions. As a technical demonstration, we assessed cross-protocol consistency using repeated acquisitions in a healthy volunteer.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了一个框架,用于直接从常规 T 1 w T_{1 }\ mathrm{w}, T 2 w T_{2}\ mathrm{w} 和 FLAIR 图像中估算一个基于 MT 模型的 MPF, 而不配对 qMT 参考数据. 我们扩展了一个物理学指导、自我监督的深入学习框架,将MT的简化封闭式描述纳入其前方信号模型。 在Teixeira等人[29]之后,该模型将MT引起的明显的纵向放松时间与依赖组织的MPF和平均RF传输功率联系起来,B 1,rms B_{1,\mathrm{rms}},后者由获取协议确定. 为了减少这些估计地图中依赖协议的变异,我们以输入扫描的获取参数作为网络的条件。 我们利用一个包含7 700多个磁共振场(23,000+图像卷)的临床多样、多中心、多毒的数据集,包括脱伤病人的诊疗,对框架进行了培训和评估。 作为技术示范,我们通过对健康的志愿人员的反复收购,评估了跨议定书的一致性。

blocks.en: MT in biological tissue is generally modeled using a two-pool framework comprising a liquid free-water pool (superscript f \mathrm{f} ) and a semisolid macromolecular pool (superscript s \mathrm{s} ) [ 2 ] . Each pool is characterized by its own longitudinal and transverse relaxation rates. However, the transverse relaxation time of the semisolid pool, T 2 s T_{2}^{\mathrm{s}} , is on the order of microseconds, preventing its direct observation with conventional MRI. Longitudinal magnetization is exchanged between the two pools with first-order rate constants k f k^{\mathrm{f}} (free to semisolid) and k s k^{\mathrm{s}} (semisolid to free) [ 29 ] .

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Clinical dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 临床数据集

blocks.en: We compiled a multicenter clinical dataset comprising 7,705 non-contrast-enhanced 3 T brain MRI sessions from 4,489 unique subjects from two different sources. The dataset combined (1) retrospectively collected examinations from the University Medical Center Utrecht (UMCU) with (2) examinations from the publicly available MR-RATE dataset acquired at Istanbul Medipol University 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/Forithmus/MR-RATE . Each session included a 3D T 1 T_{1} -weighted ( T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} ) acquisition, an axial 2D T 2 T_{2} -weighted ( T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} ) acquisition, and a 3D T 2 T_{2} -weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) acquisition. Gadolinium-enhanced T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} acquisitions were excluded. The two data sources were combined to broaden the distribution of scanner systems, pulse-sequence implementations, and acquisition parameters, including B 1 , rms B_{1,\mathrm{rms}} . Table 1 summarizes the acquisition characteristics of both datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们汇编了一个多中心临床数据集,由来自两个不同来源的4,489个独特学科的7,705个非连续增强的3个T脑核磁共振分会组成。 数据集合并了(1)从乌得勒支大学医疗中心(UMCU)追溯收集的检查和(2)从伊斯坦布尔梅迪波尔大学获得的公开的MR-RATE数据集进行的检查。 每场比赛包括一次3D T 1 T_{1} -加权(T 1 w T_{1}\mathrm{w}) 收购,一次轴2D T 2 T_{2} -加权(T 2 w_{2}\mathrm{w}) 收购,以及一次3D T 2 T_{2} -加权流体增压反演回收(FLAIR) 收购. Gadolinium-增强T 1 w T_{1}\mathrm{w} 收购被排除在外. 这两个数据源被合并,以扩大扫描仪系统的分布,脉冲序列执行,以及获取参数,包括B 1,rms B_{1,\mathrm{rms}}. 表1概述了两个数据集的获取特征。

blocks.en: The UMCU dataset expanded upon the clinical dataset used in our previous work [ 26 ] by including additional examinations acquired with a broader range of protocols. The collected data were acquired between 2016 and 2023 and processed in accordance with institutional regulations and ethical guidelines. The resulting dataset comprised 5,312 MRI sessions from 2,192 unique subjects (age range, 6–91 years; mean ± \pm standard deviation, 51.5 ± 17.6 51.5\pm 17.6 years; 51.1% male and 48.9% female). The dataset included patients with a broad range of clinical conditions, including oncological, neurodegenerative, epileptic, and vascular disorders. Examinations were performed on four different Philips 3 T MRI systems: Achieva (33.4% of sessions), Ingenia (28.4%), Ingenia CX (20.6%), and Ingenia Elition X (17.6%). The T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} acquisitions used either a 3D spoiled gradient-echo sequence (Spoiled GRE: 78.5%) or 3D magnetization-prepared rapid gradient-echo (MPRAGE; 21.5%). All T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} and FLAIR acquisitions used 2D and 3D turbo spin-echo (TSE) sequences, respectively.
blocks.zh: UMCU数据集扩展了我们先前工作中使用的临床数据集[26],增加了通过更广泛的协议获得的额外检查。 收集的数据于2016年至2023年之间获得,并按照机构条例和道德准则进行处理。 所产生的数据集包括5 312个磁共振学期,分别来自2 192个独特的科目(年龄范围,6-91岁;平均±\pm标准差,51.5±17.6 51.5\pm 17.6岁;男性51.1%,女性48.9%)。 数据集包括各种临床疾病的患者,包括肿瘤、神经退化、癫痫和血管疾病。 对四个不同的Philips 3 T核磁共振系统进行了检查:Achieva(33.4%)、Ingenia(28.4%)、Ingenia CX(20.6%)和Ingenia Elition X(17.6%)。 T 1 w T% 1 +% mathrm{w} 的获取使用了3D 变质的梯度- echo 序列( Spoiled GRE: 78.5%) 或 3D 磁化准备的快速梯度- echo( MPRAGE; 21.5%) 。 所有T 2 w T_{2}\ mathrm{w} 和 FLAIR 的收购分别使用了 2D 和 3D 涡轮旋转(TSE) 序列.

blocks.en: A subset of the MR-RATE data was selected based on the availability of the sequence parameters required for the forward signal model: TE, TR, inversion time TI, FA, and root-mean-square RF transmit field strength over the sequence ( B 1 , rms B_{1,\mathrm{rms}} ). These criteria yielded 2,393 MRI sessions from 2,297 unique subjects, acquired between 2023 and 2026 (age range, 13–93 years; mean ± \pm standard deviation, 42.0 ± 17.7 42.0\pm 17.7 years; 43.2% male and 56.8% female). All selected examinations were acquired on a Siemens Magnetom Vida 3 T system using 3D MPRAGE for T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} , 2D TSE for T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} , and 3D TSE for FLAIR.
blocks.zh: 根据前进信号模型所需序列参数的可用性,选定了MR-RATE数据的一个子集: TE,TR,反转时间TI,FA,以及root-mean-square RF在序列上传输场强度(B 1,rms B_{1,\mathrm{rms}}). 这些标准从2023年至2026年之间获得的2 297个特殊学科(年龄范围,13-93岁;平均 ± pm 标准偏差,42.0 ± 17.7 42.0\pm 17.7岁;43.2%为男性,56.8%为女性)。 所有选定的考试都是在Siemens Magnetom Vida 3 T系统上进行的,使用3D MPRAGE为T 1 w T_{1 }\mathrm{w},2D TSE为T 2 w_{2 }\mathrm{w},3D TSE为FLAIR.

blocks.en: For each dataset, unique subjects were randomly assigned to the training, validation, and test sets using proportions of 80%, 5%, and 15%, respectively. All MRI sessions from the same subject were assigned to the same partition to prevent subject-level data leakage. We then combined the corresponding partitions from both datasets for model training, validation, and testing. The final training set comprised 6,084 sessions from 3,595 subjects, the validation set comprised 384 sessions from 225 subjects, and the test set comprised 1,237 sessions from 669 subjects. Table 2 summarizes the partition sizes.
blocks.zh: 对每个数据集,将独特的科目随机分配给培训、验证和测试组,分别使用80%、5%和15%的比例。 同一主题的所有核磁共振会话都被分配到同一个分区,以防止主题一级的数据泄漏. 然后,我们将两个数据集的相应分区合并起来,用于模型培训、验证和测试。 最后一批培训由3 595个科目的6 084个课程组成,鉴定组由225个科目的384个课程组成,测试组由669个科目的1 237个课程组成。 表2概述了分区大小。

blocks.en: MR-RATE provides pathology labels derived automatically from the accompanying radiology reports. Within the MR-RATE test set, 70 sessions from 65 subjects carried the label “demyelinating disease of the central nervous system” (mean age, 34.4 ± 11.0 34.4\pm 11.0 years; 35.4% male and 64.6% female). Because diagnostic labels were not available for the UMCU dataset, the radiologist in our team (J.W.D.) performed a targeted review and identified four test-set subjects with clinically confirmed MS. This targeted review was not intended to identify all subjects with MS in the UMCU test set. Supplementary Table S1.1 provides the demographic and acquisition characteristics of these four subjects.
blocks.zh: MR-RATE提供从所附的放射学报告自动衍生出来的病理学标签. 在MR-RATE测试中,65个学科的70个课程都标有“中枢神经系统致命性疾病”(平均年龄为34.4±11.0 34.4\pm 11.0岁;男性为35.4%,女性为64.6%)。 由于UMCU数据集没有诊断标签,我们团队的放射科医生(J.W.D.)进行了有针对性的审查,并确定了四个具有临床上证实的MS的测试对象. 这一目标明确的审查并不是要确定在UMCU测试集中与MS有关的所有主题. 补充表S1.1列出了这四个科目的人口和购置特点。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Data preprocessing
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 国家 数据处理

blocks.en: The UMCU MRIs were converted from DICOM to NIfTI format using dcm2niix [ 33 ] . We extracted sequence parameters from the DICOM headers. The MR-RATE dataset was already in NIfTI format, and we obtained the corresponding sequence parameters from the accompanying metadata files.
blocks.zh: UMCU mRIs由DICOM转换为NIfTI格式,使用dcm2niix [33]. 我们从DICOM头部提取了序列参数. MR-RATE数据集已经采用NIfTI格式,我们从配套的元数据文件中获得了相应的序列参数.

blocks.en: All MRI sessions from the combined dataset underwent a series of preprocessing steps. First, all T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} acquisitions were resampled to an in-plane resolution of 1 × 1 ​ mm 1\times 1\text{ mm} while preserving their native slice thickness. Across the combined dataset, the native T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} slice thickness was either 3.0 or 4.0 mm. Second, the 3D T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} and FLAIR images were rigidly registered and resampled onto the voxel grid of the corresponding resampled 2D T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} acquisition using ANTsPy [ 34 ] . Third, a brain mask was generated from the T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} image using HD-BET [ 35 ] , and all images were skull stripped using the resulting mask. Fourth, N4 bias-field correction [ 36 ] was applied to the skull-stripped T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} , T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} , and FLAIR images. Fifth, axial slices were center-cropped or zero-padded to a matrix size of 224 × 224 224\times 224 voxels. Finally, superior and inferior slices with low signal-to-noise ratio were excluded to reduce artifacts. Before training and inference of our proposed framework, each input image was independently normalized by dividing all voxel intensities by the histogram mode of the corresponding whole-brain volume.
blocks.zh: 综合数据集的所有磁共振场均经过了一系列预处理步骤。 首先,所有T 2 w T_{2}\ mathrm{w} 的收购被重印到1×1mm 1\times 1\text{ mm}的飞机内分辨率,同时保留其原生的切片厚度. 在综合数据集中,原生的T 2 w T →% 2 → mathrm{w} 切片厚度为3.0或4.0毫米。 其次,3D T 1 w T_{1}\mathrm{w} 和 FLAIR 图像被刚性地注册并重印到相应重印的 2D T 2 w_{2}\mathrm{w} 使用 ANTsPy [34] 获取的 voxel 网格上. 第三,通过使用HD-BET[35]的T 1 w T_{1}\ mathrm{w}图像生成了一个脑罩,所有图像都使用由此而来的面具剥离了头骨. 第四,N4偏偏-场校正 [36] 被应用到头盖骨尖的T 1 w T_{1}\ mathrm{w},T 2 w_{2_{ mathrm{w}和 FLAIR 图像中. 第五,轴切片被中央或零加成224×224\times 224 voxels的矩阵大小. 最后,将信号与噪音比率低的优劣切片排除在外,以减少文物。 在培训和推断我们拟议的框架之前,每个输入图像都独立地正常化,将所有阴道强度除以相应的全脑体积的直方图模式。

blocks.en: To obtain tissue masks, we applied SynthSeg [ 37 ] to the preprocessed T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} images from each MRI session. White matter (WM) and gray matter (GM) masks were extracted from the resulting segmentations. To reduce partial-volume contamination from cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), we excluded WM and GM voxels located within 2.0 ​ mm 2.0~\mathrm{mm} of CSF.
blocks.zh: 为了获得组织口罩,我们把SynthSeg [37] 应用到预处理的T 1 w T_{1}\ mathrm{w}每次磁共振会话的图像上. 白色物质(WM)和灰色物质(GM)的口罩是从产生的分解中提取的. 为了减少脑脊液(CSF)的部分体积污染,我们排除了位于CSF 2.0毫米范围内的WM和GM voxels.

blocks.en: For the demyelinating lesion analyses, we segmented WM lesions using LST-AI, a deep learning model developed and trained for MS lesion segmentation on paired T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} and FLAIR images [ 38 ] . Segmentation was performed for the four manually identified UMCU subjects with MS and the 70 MR-RATE MRI sessions with the demyelinating disease label. LST-AI was applied to the native-resolution, full-head T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} and FLAIR acquisitions selected from each MRI session before any preprocessing steps. The resulting lesion masks were aligned with the preprocessed images using the same rigid transformation and resampling procedure applied during preprocessing. Lesion voxels were excluded from the WM masks to define normal-appearing white matter (NAWM) and gray matter (NAGM) for these MRI sessions.

blocks.en: 3.2 Model
blocks.zh: 3.2 型号

blocks.en: We extended our previously proposed physics-guided self-supervised framework for retrospective qMRI mapping from conventional clinical scans [ 26 ] by incorporating the MT-informed apparent longitudinal relaxation model into the differentiable forward signal model (Eqs. ( 4 )–( 8 )). This extension enables the multi-contrast convolutional neural network (CNN) to estimate voxel-wise maps of the free-pool longitudinal relaxation time ( T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} ), free-pool transverse relaxation time ( T 2 f T_{2}^{\mathrm{f}} ), PD \mathrm{PD} , and macromolecular pool fraction ( m 0 s m_{0}^{\mathrm{s}} ; MPF) directly from routine T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} , T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} , and FLAIR acquisitions. Training remains self-supervised and does not require reference quantitative maps, which are not available.
blocks.zh: 我们通过将MT知情的明显纵向放松模型纳入不同的前方信号模型(Eqs. (4) – (8)),扩展了我们先前提出的从常规临床扫描中追溯qMRI绘图的物理指导自我监督框架。 这个扩展让多孔的转录神经网络(CNN)能够对自由池纵向放松时间(T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}}),自由池横向放松时间(T 2 f_{2}^{\mathrm{f}}),PD\mathrm{PD},以及宏分子池分数(m 0 s_{0}^{\mathrm{s}};MPF)直接从常规T 1 w T_{1_{mathrm{w},T 2 w_{2}\mathrm{w},以及FLAIR收购. 培训仍然是自我监督的,不需要参考定量地图,这些地图是没有的。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Network architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 网络架构

blocks.en: The network retains the three-level 2D U-Net architecture described in [ 26 ] . A shared-weight encoder processes each input contrast of an MRI session separately, and attention-based contrast-fusion modules combine the resulting feature representations at each resolution level. The fused features are passed to a common decoder with skip connections from the corresponding encoder levels. The network operates on 2D axial slices of 224 × 224 224\times 224 voxels.
blocks.zh: 网络保留[26]中描述的三级2D U-Net架构. 一个共享加权编码器处理一个磁共振会话的每个输入对比,基于注意力的对比组合模块结合了由此产生的每个分辨率层次的特征表示. 引信的特性被传递给一个普通的解码器,并带有来自相应编码器级的跳过连接. 该网络以224×224×224\时的2D轴切片224Voxels运行.

A Sigmoid activation function constrained the outputs to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , after which they were linearly scaled to physical ranges of [ 0 , 5 ] [0,5] s for T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} , [ 0 , 3 ] [0,3] s for T 2 f T_{2}^{\mathrm{f}} , [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] arbitrary units for PD \mathrm{PD} , and [ 0 , 0.4 ] [0,0.4] for m 0 s m_{0}^{\mathrm{s}} . blocks.zh: 3.2.3 培训程序和执行细节

blocks.en: The network was trained on the full combined dataset for 20 epochs using the Adam optimizer [ 49 ] with momentum parameters β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 and β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}=0.999 . Network weights were initialized using Kaiming initialization [ 50 ] . Each training batch consisted of slices randomly sampled from the entire training dataset. To identify the optimal model configuration, hyperparameter optimization was performed using a grid search. Table S3.1 in the Supplementary Materials summarizes the search space and explored values. Furthermore, the necessity of the two regularization terms ( PD-constraint and T 1 ​ - ​ prior T_{1}\text{-}\mathrm{prior} ) was evaluated through an ablation study, detailed in Supplementary Materials S7 . Model selection was based on minimizing validation loss while ensuring quantitative outputs matched physiologically expected ranges for human brain qMT literature values in WM and GM [ 48 , 3 , 46 ] .
blocks.zh: 网络接受了20个纪元全集数据集的培训,使用了亚当优化器[49],动力参数为β 1 = 0.9\β1}=0.9,β 2 = 0.999\β2}=0.999. 网络权重通过启明初始化初始化[50]. 每批培训由从整个培训数据集随机抽取的片段组成。 为了确定最佳模型配置,利用网格搜索进行了超参数优化. 补充材料中的表S3.1概括了搜索空间和探索值。 此外,两个规范化术语(PD-约束和T 1----前T_{1}\text{-}\mathrm{prior})的必要性通过一项减征研究得到了评估,详见补充材料S7。 模型选择的基础是最大限度地减少验证损失,同时确保量化产出符合人类大脑qMT文献值在WM和GM[48、3、46]的生理预期范围。

blocks.en: The final model was trained using a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , a batch size of 16 slices, and regularization weights λ T 1 ​ - ​ prior = 0.0025 \lambda_{T_{1}\text{-}\mathrm{prior}}=0.0025 and λ PD ​ - ​ constraint = 0.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{PD\text{-}constraint}}=0.5 . We developed the implementation in Python 3.11.9 using PyTorch 2.1.2 [ 51 ] , with data loading, preprocessing, and slice sampling handled by TorchIO 0.20.6 [ 52 ] . Training was performed on a single NVIDIA RTX 4500 Ada Generation GPU and took approximately 12 hours. The complete PyTorch implementation and pretrained network weights are available on GitHub: https://github.com/JelmervanL/MPF-mapping-from-conventional-MRI .

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价

blocks.en: We evaluated the biological plausibility and protocol robustness of the generated MPF ( m 0 s m_{0}^{\mathrm{s}} ) maps, their sensitivity to demyelinating pathology, their cross-protocol reproducibility, and the contribution of acquisition-conditioned AdaIN.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了生成的MPF(m 0 s _{0 s}^{\0 }^{\ mathrm{s}})地图的生物学可信度和协议稳健性,它们对于解密病理的敏感性,它们的跨议定书可复制性,以及获得条件的AdaIN的贡献.

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Macromolecular pool fraction in white matter and gray matter
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 白物质和灰物质中的大分子池碎片

blocks.en: Estimated MPF values were evaluated in WM and GM across the full clinical test set ( n = 1,237 n=1{,}237 ). To assess robustness against scanner and protocol variation, sessions were stratified into three vendor-by-protocol groups based on the T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} acquisition: Philips Spoiled GRE, Philips MPRAGE, and Siemens MPRAGE. Stratification was based on the T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} sequence because it exhibited the largest protocol variation in the dataset, including differences in pulse-sequence type. In contrast, T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} and FLAIR acquisitions consistently employed turbo spin-echo sequences across the entire dataset, differing primarily in timing parameters ( TR \mathrm{TR} , TE \mathrm{TE} , and TI \mathrm{TI} ). We quantified protocol stability using the between-group coefficient of variation (CV) of tissue-specific mean MPF values. The CV was calculated as the standard deviation of the three group means, each obtained by averaging the per-session means within that group, divided by the unweighted mean of the three group means.
blocks.zh: 在WM和GM全临床测试中评估了估计的MPF值(n=1,237n=1{,}237)。 为了对照扫描仪和协议的变异来评估稳健性,根据T 1 w T_{1 }\ mathrm{w} 收购,会议分成三个逐个供应商组: Philips Spoiled GRE, Philips MPRAGE,和西门子MPRAGE. 分级基于T 1 w T_{1}\mathrm{w} 序列,因为它显示了数据集中最大的协议变异,包括脉冲序列类型的差异. 与此相反,T 2 w T_{2}\ mathrm{w} 和FLAIR收购 在整个数据集中始终使用涡轮旋转-echo序列,主要在时间参数上有所不同(TR\mathrm{TR},TE\mathrm{TE}和TI\mathrm{TI})。 我们使用特定组织平均分子系数变化的组间系数来量化协议稳定性。 CV是按三个组的标准偏差表示的,每组均通过该组内每场的平均值获得,除以三个组的未加权平均值表示.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Demyelinating pathology
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 消除病变

blocks.en: Sensitivity to demyelinating pathology was evaluated using the 70 MR-RATE test sessions with report-derived demyelinating-disease labels and the four UMCU test sessions with confirmed MS. Mean MPF values within segmented WM lesions were compared with NAWM and NAGM using relative percentage differences.
blocks.zh: 利用70次MR-RATE试验会及报告衍生的去麻碱-病症标签和四次UMCU试验会及经确认的MS,对去麻碱性病理学的敏感性进行了评价。 利用相对百分比的差别,将分块的妇幼保健损伤中平均多配偶单位值与NAWM和NAGM进行比较。

blocks.en: Furthermore, because T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} and m 0 s m_{0}^{\mathrm{s}} jointly determine R 1 app R_{1}^{\mathrm{app}} in the forward signal model (Eq. ( 4 )), we also assessed whether their estimates covaried across individual lesions. Following the approach of Assländer et al. [3] , individual lesions were defined as distinct three-dimensional connected components of the WM lesion masks. Components containing fewer than 10 voxels were excluded from the analysis. Each lesion was represented by its median m 0 s m_{0}^{\mathrm{s}} and free-pool longitudinal relaxation rate ( R 1 f = 1 / T 1 f R_{1}^{\mathrm{f}}=1/T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} ). Principal component analysis (PCA) of these paired lesion-level estimates quantified the dominant direction of joint variation and the remaining variation orthogonal to this direction.
3.3.3 Prospective volunteer reproducibility
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 潜在的志愿再生产

blocks.en: As a technical demonstration, prospective cross-protocol reproducibility of the generated MPF maps was evaluated in a 26-year-old male volunteer scanned on a 3 T Philips Ingenia system with written informed consent and institutional review board approval. The volunteer was considered healthy based on the absence of visible lesions on the acquired images. Two clinical protocols, each comprising a separate set of T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} , T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} , and FLAIR acquisitions, were performed consecutively within the same scanning session. The protocols differed primarily in the T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} sequence, which used Spoiled GRE in one protocol and MPRAGE in the other; detailed acquisition characteristics are provided in Supplementary Table S4.1 . The prospective data were preprocessed using the same pipeline as the clinical dataset. Voxel-wise agreement between the generated MPF maps was assessed across brain parenchyma (WM + GM) using the mean absolute percentage difference, Pearson correlation coefficient ( r r ), and concordance correlation coefficient (CCC).
blocks.zh: 作为技术示范,一名26岁的男性志愿人员在经过书面知情同意和机构审查委员会批准的3T Philips Ingenia系统扫描后,对生成的MPF地图的跨议定书可复制性进行了评估。 该志愿人员被认为健康,因为所获得的图像没有明显的损伤。 两个临床协议,每个协议由一套单独的T 1 w T_{1}\mathrm{w},T 2 w_{2_{mathrm{w},以及FLAIR收购,在同一扫描会话中连续执行. 这些协议主要在T 1 w T_{1}\ mathrm{w} 序列中有所不同,该序列在一个协议中使用了被破坏的GRE,在另一个协议中使用了MPRAGE;在补充表S4.1中提供了详细的获取特性. 利用与临床数据集相同的管道对预期数据进行了预处理。 利用平均绝对百分比差、皮尔逊相关系数(r r r)和一致性相关系数(CCC),评估了生成的MPF地图之间的Voxel-wise协议。

blocks.en: 3.3.4 Impact of acquisition-conditioned AdaIN
blocks.zh: 3.3.4 国家 购置条件AdaIN的影响

blocks.en: Finally, the contribution of acquisition-conditioned AdaIN was assessed through an ablation experiment in which all AdaIN layers were replaced with standard instance normalization, while all other model and training settings were kept unchanged. Performance was compared using test-set L1 reconstruction error, the between-group CV of tissue MPF estimates across vendor-by-protocol groups, and cross-protocol agreement in the prospective volunteer.
blocks.zh: 最后,通过减征实验评估了购置条件的AdaIN的贡献,在减征实验中,所有AdaIN层被标准实例正常化所取代,而所有其他模型和培训环境则保持不变。 利用测试集L1重建错误、各个供应商小组的MPF组织估计数的组间CV以及未来志愿人员的跨组协议,对性能进行了比较。

blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced a physics-guided, self-supervised deep learning framework for retrospectively estimating MPF from conventional T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} , T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} , and FLAIR brain MRI without paired qMT data. The framework extends retrospective quantitative MRI mapping by incorporating an analytical two-pool MT model that relates apparent longitudinal relaxation to sequence-averaged RF power, together with acquisition-conditioned AdaIN to account for differences among acquisition protocols. We trained and evaluated the framework using a large multicenter, multivendor clinical dataset and examined tissue-level MPF estimates, sensitivity to demyelinating pathology, vendor/protocol robustness, and the contribution of AdaIN acquisition conditioning.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了一个物理导引,自我监督的深层学习框架,从常规T 1 w T_{1}\mathrm{w},T 2 w2_{mathrm{w},以及FLAIR脑核磁共振不配对qMT数据进行追溯性估计. 该框架将追溯性定量核磁共振图绘制工作扩大到一个分析的双集合MT模型,该模型与测序平均RF功率的明显纵向放松有关,并附有购置条件的AdaIN,以说明购置协议之间的差异。 我们利用一个大型多中心、多毒的临床数据集对框架进行培训和评估,并检查了组织层面的多毒多毒的多毒多毒的临床数据集、对去菌病理学的敏感性、销售商/议定书的稳健性以及AdaIN采购条件的贡献。

blocks.en:
We first assessed whether the retrospectively estimated MPF maps showed expected values for WM and GM. Across the clinical test set, estimated MPF was consistently higher in WM ( 0.182 ± 0.007 0.182\pm 0.007 ) than in GM ( 0.144 ± 0.009 0.144\pm 0.009 ), in agreement with the higher macromolecular and myelin content of WM [ 53 , 4 ] . These tissue mean values fell within the ranges reported by qMT studies that model distinct longitudinal relaxation rates for the free and semisolid pools ( m 0 s ∈ [ 0.17 , 0.27 ] m_{0}^{\mathrm{s}}\in[0.17,0.27] in WM and m 0 s ∈ [ 0.08 , 0.18 ] m_{0}^{\mathrm{s}}\in[0.08,0.18] across cortical and subcortical GM) [ 54 , 46 , 55 , 3 , 30 ] .
However, absolute MPF values should be compared cautiously across studies, as they depend on the fitting strategy and the assumptions and constraints of the two-pool model. In particular, our estimates were higher than values commonly obtained using models that use the constraint T 1 s = T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{s}}=T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} [ 56 , 16 , 17 ] . Previous studies have shown that this constraint can substantially underestimate the semisolid pool fraction [ 54 , 46 , 3 ] . In contrast, our model fixes T 1 s T_{1}^{\mathrm{s}} to the substantially shorter value of 300 ​ ms 300~\mathrm{ms} [ 54 , 46 , 3 , 30 ] and estimates T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} voxel-wise. This difference in model assumptions likely contributes to the higher MPF estimates obtained with our framework.

blocks.en: Despite the tissue means falling within reported ranges, the contrast between WM and GM was smaller than expected. The GM-to-WM MPF ratio was approximately 0.79 0.79 , whereas prospective qMT studies using both constrained and unconstrained two-pool models have generally reported ratios closer to 0.5 0.5 [ 56 , 16 , 3 ] . Our generated maps preserved the expected ordering of WM and GM values but showed reduced MPF contrast between these tissues. This reduced tissue contrast may stem from model simplifications, globally fixed semisolid-pool and exchange parameters, the WM-specific T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} prior, and partial-volume effects, as discussed further in Section 5.1 .
blocks.zh: 尽管组织意味着在报告的范围之内,但WM和GM之间的对比小于预期。 GM-WM MPF比约为0.79 0.79,而使用受约束和不受约束的双库模型的预期qMT研究一般报告的比率接近0.5 [56、16、3]。 我们生成的地图保留了WM值和GM值的预期顺序,但显示这些组织之间的MPF对比降低。 这种组织对比的缩小可能源于模型简化、全球固定的半固态池和交换参数、WM特有的T 1 f T_{1}^{\ mathrm{f}} 之前,以及部分量效应,详见第5.1节。

blocks.en:
In segmented lesions, MPF was 35.6% lower than in NAWM in the MR-RATE demyelinating-disease subset, consistent with reductions of 23.5–34.2% in the four UMCU subjects with confirmed MS. These decreases align with prospective quantitative MT literature reporting substantial macromolecular pool reductions in MS lesions [ 3 , 4 ] , where relative decreases typically range from 30% to 45% compared to NAWM [ 57 , 58 , 9 , 59 ] . This agreement supports the sensitivity of the generated MPF maps to tissue alterations associated with demyelinating pathology.
To assess the extent to which lesion-wise MPF and R 1 f R_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} estimates covaried, we performed PCA on their paired values. The first principal component explained 91% of their joint variance (Figure 5 ). This proportion was similar to the 93% reported by Assländer et al. [3] for dedicated prospective qMT under the constraint of equal longitudinal relaxation times for the free and semisolid pools ( T 1 s = T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{s}}=T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} ). Thus, our retrospectively estimated quantitative maps showed a similar degree of joint variation between lesion-wise R 1 f R_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} and MPF to that observed with prospective qMT. Section 5.1 discusses limitations related to the report-derived diagnoses, lesion segmentations, and clinical characterization of the data.

blocks.en: For retrospective application to heterogeneous clinical MRI archives, MPF estimates must remain stable across acquisition protocols and scanner systems. Across the multicenter test cohort, mean MPF varied little among the three vendor-by-protocol groups, with between-group CVs of 2.65% in WM and 5.63% in GM, despite differences in scanner vendor, sequence implementation, timing parameters, and RF power. The prospective within-subject experiment further supported this protocol robustness: MPF maps estimated from consecutive Spoiled GRE and MPRAGE acquisitions showed good voxel-wise agreement (CCC = 0.888 =0.888 ) and a mean absolute percentage difference of 7.7% (Figures 6 and 7 ).
blocks.zh: 对于多种临床磁共振档案的追溯应用,磁共振估计必须在整个采购协议和扫描系统之间保持稳定。 尽管扫描仪供应商、序列实施、时间参数和RF功率各有不同,但是在多中心测试组中,每个供应商组的MPF差别很小,组的CV在WM为2.65%,在GM为5.63%。 潜在主体内试验进一步支持了这项议定书的稳健性: 从连续的被破坏的GRE和MPRAGE收购中估计的MPF地图显示,顺阴性协议良好(CCC=0.888=0.888),平均绝对百分比差异为7.7%(图6和图7)。

blocks.en: Acquisition-conditioned AdaIN contributed substantially to this stability. Replacing AdaIN with standard instance normalization substantially increased the between-group CV of MPF, and reduced cross-protocol agreement in the prospective volunteer, with the CCC decreasing from 0.888 0.888 to 0.672 0.672 (Supplementary Materials S6 ). This finding is consistent with other quantitative mapping frameworks showing that conditioning neural networks on sequence parameters improves performance across heterogeneous acquisition settings [ 42 , 43 ] . However, protocol hold-out experiments indicated limited generalization to sequence types absent from the training data (Supplementary Materials S8 ). Robust deployment across clinical archives therefore requires representative coverage of the target sequence types during training.
blocks.zh: 有条件购置 AdaIN对这一稳定作出了重大贡献。 以标准实例取代AdaIN,大大提高了MPF团体之间的CV,减少了未来志愿人员的跨议定书协议,CCC从0.888 0.888减少到0.672 0.672(补充材料S6)。 这一结论与其他定量绘图框架相一致,这些框架表明,以序列参数为神经网络配置可改善不同获取环境的性能[42、43]。 然而,协议搁置试验表明,培训数据(补充材料S8)中缺少的序列类型一般化有限。 因此,在临床档案中大力部署,需要在培训期间对目标序列类型进行具有代表性的覆盖。

blocks.en: The observed protocol stability is particularly relevant given the ill-posed nature of the parameter-estimation problem. The framework estimates four quantitative maps ( m 0 s m_{0}^{\mathrm{s}} , T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} , T 2 f T_{2}^{\mathrm{f}} , and PD \mathrm{PD} ) from only three conventional image contrasts ( T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} , T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} , and FLAIR). Moreover, as discussed in the Methods (Section 3.2.2 ), T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} and m 0 s m_{0}^{\mathrm{s}} exhibit a specific identifiability problem. To constrain the solution space, the model incorporates two regularizers: a WM-specific T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} prior and a soft lower bound on PD \mathrm{PD} . The importance of these regularizers was evaluated by the ablation study (Supplementary Materials S7 ). Removing the WM T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} prior caused shifts in T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} and MPF, increased differences between vendor-by-protocol groups, and reduced cross-protocol agreement in the prospective volunteer experiment. Removing the PD \mathrm{PD} constraint primarily affected the estimated PD \mathrm{PD} and T 2 f T_{2}^{\mathrm{f}} maps and increased vendor-by-protocol group variation. These findings suggest that the regularization improves the stability and reproducibility of the generated quantitative maps. This is consistent with previous physics-guided self-supervised approaches that used similar regularizers to derive quantitative maps from conventional MRI [ 26 , 27 ] . Beyond these regularization constraints, protocol-dependent variation in sequence-averaged RF power ( B 1 , rms B_{1,\mathrm{rms}} ) provides additional information that may help distinguish the contributions of T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} and m 0 s m_{0}^{\mathrm{s}} to the observed image intensities. Combining the UMCU and MR-RATE datasets broadened the range of acquisition protocols and corresponding B 1 , rms B_{1,\mathrm{rms}} values represented during training (Table 1 ).

blocks.en: 5.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.1 限制

blocks.en: Several limitations should be considered when interpreting our findings. First, the framework relies on simplified descriptions of MT and conventional MRI signal formation. The analytical MT model adopted from Teixeira et al. [ 29 ] incorporates several assumptions, as described in the Theory section (Section 2 ). In addition, the Bloch-based signal equations do not account for factors such as B 1 B_{1} inhomogeneity or detailed echo-train dynamics. More comprehensive approaches, including the MT models proposed by Graham and Henkelman [60] , and Sled and Pike [7] , EPG-X [ 61 ] , and the generalized Bloch model [ 22 ] , may provide more accurate descriptions of these effects. However, these methods generally require detailed sequence information that is often unavailable in retrospective clinical MRI archives.
blocks.zh: 在解释我们的调查结果时,应考虑若干限制。 首先,框架依赖于对MT和常规核磁共振信号形成的简化描述. Teixeira等人采用的分析MT模型。 [29] 包含若干假设,如理论部分(第2节)所述。 此外,基于布洛赫的信号方程并不考虑诸如B 1 B_{1}不均匀性或详细的回声-列车动力学等因素. 更为全面的方法,包括Graham和Henkelman提出的MT模型[60],以及Sled和Pike[7],EPG-X[61],以及通用的Bloch模型[22],可以更准确地描述这些效果. 然而,这些方法一般需要详细的序列信息,而这种信息往往在追溯性临床核磁共振档案中得不到。

blocks.en: The model also relies on fixed tissue parameters and explicit regularization to constrain parameter estimation. We fixed the exchange and semisolid relaxation parameters to literature values reported for healthy WM and applied them to all tissues and subjects. Because these parameters vary across tissue types and may also change with pathology [ 3 ] , applying fixed healthy-WM values to all tissues and subjects may bias the estimated MPF. Moreover, although the WM-specific T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} prior and soft lower bound on PD \mathrm{PD} improved model stability, they constrained the range of admissible solutions and made the estimated parameter maps dependent on the selected regularization settings.
blocks.zh: 该模型还依赖于固定组织参数和明确的正规化来制约参数估计. 我们把交换和半固态放松参数 固定在健康WM的文献值上 并将其应用到所有组织和主体上 因为这些参数因组织类型而异,也可能随病理学[3]而变化,对所有组织和对象应用固定的健康-WM值可能会使估计的MPF产生偏差. 此外,虽然WM特有的T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}}在PD\mathrm{PD}上前加软的下限,提高了模型稳定性,但它们限制了可接受解决方案的范围,使估计参数地图依赖于选定的正则设置.

blocks.en: In addition to these modeling assumptions, the heterogeneous acquisition geometry of clinical MRI imposed spatial limitations, as previously discussed in [ 26 ] . We registered all MRI contrasts to the 2D T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} acquisition geometry and resampled them to an in-plane resolution of 1 × 1 1\times 1 mm. This procedure reduced the through-plane resolution of the original 3D T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} and FLAIR images and removed volumetric detail. Registration errors and partial-volume effects may also propagate into the estimated parameter maps. Moreover, slice-wise processing does not use spatial information from adjacent slices.
blocks.zh: 除了这些建模假设外,临床核磁共振的多种获取几何学也造成了空间限制,正如先前在[26]中所讨论的那样。 我们登记了所有核磁共振与2D T 2 w T_{2}\ mathrm{w} 获取几何的对比,并将它们重新复制到1×1 1\1毫米的飞机内分辨率. 这一程序降低了原3D T 1 w T_{1}\mathrm{w}和FLAIR图像的通过飞机分辨率,并移除了音量细节. 登记错误和部分量效应也可能传播到估计参数地图中。 此外,切片处理不使用来自相邻切片的空间信息.

blocks.en: The evaluation design also has several limitations. Establishing the absolute accuracy of the MPF maps remains challenging because no universally accepted qMT reference standard exists [ 62 , 4 ] . Available qMT methods differ in sequence design, fitting procedures, and the constraints imposed on the two-pool model, which can lead to systematic differences in the estimated MPF [ 4 ] . Comparison with a dedicated prospective qMT implementation would therefore establish agreement with that specific methodology, rather than establishing absolute biological accuracy. In the absence of paired qMT data, we evaluated the generated MPF maps through complementary measures of biological plausibility, sensitivity to demyelinating pathology, stability across vendor-by-protocol groups, and prospective cross-protocol reproducibility. Furthermore, these analyses relied on tissue segmentations derived from clinical MRI, which may be inaccurate in the presence of lesions, anatomical abnormalities, or limited image quality. Errors in the WM and GM masks may affect the reported tissue-level MPF estimates, while errors in the automated WM lesion segmentations may affect the lesion analysis. Moreover, we relied primarily on report-derived diagnostic labels to evaluate demyelinating pathology, and FLAIR-hyperintense white-matter lesions are not specific to demyelination. The four clinically confirmed MS UMCU cases supported the findings but did not constitute a systematic validation cohort. These caveats should be considered when interpreting the observed reduction in lesion MPF. Future studies should evaluate the framework in clinically characterized cohorts with expert tissue and lesion annotations.
blocks.zh: 评价设计也有一些局限性。 由于不存在普遍接受的qMT参考标准[62,4],确定MPF地图的绝对准确性仍然具有挑战性. 可用的qMT方法在序列设计,配装程序,以及对双集合模型施加的限制方面各不相同,这可能导致估计的MPF[4]的系统差异. 因此,与一个专门预期的qMT执行比较,将可与这一具体方法取得一致,而不是确定绝对的生物准确性。 在缺乏对等的qMT数据的情况下,我们通过生物可信性、对去除病理的敏感性、各供应商群体之间的稳定性和可能的跨议定书再生产等补充措施,对生成的MPF地图进行了评估。 此外,这些分析依赖于临床核磁共振产生的组织分裂,在出现损伤、解剖异常或图像质量有限的情况下,这种分裂可能不准确。 WM和GM口罩的误差可能影响所报告的组织层次的MPF估计,而自动WM损伤分解的误差可能影响损伤分析. 此外,我们主要依靠从报告中得到的诊断标签来评估脱伤病理学,而FLAIR-hyperintense白物质损伤并非是脱伤的特有特征。 临床上证实的4例MS UMCU病例支持了调查结果,但并不构成系统验证组。 在解释观察到的减少损害的多氯联苯时应考虑这些警告。 今后的研究应评估临床特征人群的框架,并附有专家组织和损伤说明。

blocks.en: While the large and heterogeneous clinical dataset enabled evaluation across multiple vendors and protocols, the vendor-by-protocol groups differed in patient demographics. As a result, biological variability across the populations confounded the group comparisons, preventing an independent assessment of the effects of vendor and protocol on MPF estimates. Moreover, all MRIs were acquired at 3 T, and protocol diversity was concentrated mainly in the T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} acquisitions; other common acquisitions, including 3D T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} and 2D FLAIR, were not represented. Generalizability beyond the scanner systems and acquisition protocols represented in this study remains to be established. In particular, protocol hold-out experiments showed substantial parameter shifts for T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} sequence types absent from training (Supplementary Materials S8 ); the framework should therefore not be applied to unseen sequence types without retraining or dedicated validation. Finally, the prospective reproducibility experiment included only a single healthy volunteer and should therefore be considered a technical demonstration; larger, dedicated cohorts are required to prospectively assess cross-protocol and cross-vendor reproducibility more comprehensively.
blocks.zh: 虽然大型和多样化的临床数据集能够对多个供应商和协议进行评价,但逐个供应商群体在病人人口统计上有所不同。 因此,各种群的生物变异使群体比较无法进行,妨碍了对供应商的影响进行独立评估,也妨碍了对多指标类集计算估计的规程。 此外,所有MRI都是在3 T收购的,协议多样性主要集中于T 1 w T_{1}\mathrm{w}收购;其他常见的收购,包括3D T 2 w_{2}\mathrm{w}和2D FLAIR,没有代表. 除了本研究所代表的扫描系统和采购规程之外,通用性仍有待确定。 特别是,协议搁置的实验显示,T 1 w _{1 }\ mathrm{w} 序列类型在培训中缺失(补充材料S8),其参数发生了实质性变化;因此,框架不应适用于看不见的序列类型,而无需再培训或专门验证。 最后,预期的可复制性试验只包括一名健康的志愿人员,因此应视为技术示范;需要更多、专门的团体对跨议定书和跨供应商可复制性进行更全面的预期评估。

blocks.en: 5.2 Outlook
blocks.zh: 5.2 展望

blocks.en: By deriving MPF maps directly from routine T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} , T 2 ​ w T_{2}\mathrm{w} , and FLAIR scans, the framework enables quantitative MT analysis without dedicated qMT acquisitions. The framework can generate MPF maps from existing multicenter conventional clinical imaging archives, supporting large-scale retrospective biomarker research. Applied prospectively, it can provide MPF as a quantitative biomarker without increasing scan time and may support longitudinal analysis of lesions in patients undergoing repeated clinical MRI. Although the present study focuses on MS, the proposed MPF mapping approach may also enable investigation of macromolecular tissue changes in other neurological conditions. Potential applications include Alzheimer’s disease [ 63 , 64 ] , Parkinson’s disease [ 65 ] , Huntington’s disease [ 66 ] , and myelin damage and repair after stroke [ 67 ] .

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Physics-guided self-supervised learning enables retrospective estimation of MPF maps from conventional clinical brain MRI without requiring paired qMT reference data. Across heterogeneous protocols, the resulting maps showed good consistency and marked MPF reductions in lesions of patients with demyelinating disease. This highlights the framework’s potential for large-scale biomarker research using existing clinical imaging archives. It may also enable prospective MPF mapping from conventional MRI without requiring a dedicated qMT acquisition or additional scan time.
blocks.zh: 由物理指导的自我监督的学习能够对常规临床大脑核磁共振图进行追溯性估计,而不需要配对的qMT参考数据. 所制作的图谱各式各样,都显示出良好的一致性,并显著减少了脱伤性疾病患者的损伤。 这突出了该框架利用现有临床成像档案进行大规模生物标记研究的潜力。 也可以使常规核磁共振中可能的磁共振绘图无需专门获得qMT或额外扫描时间。

blocks.en: Appendix S8 Generalization to unseen T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} protocols
blocks.zh: 附录 S8 通缩到看不见的 T 1 w T_{1}\ mathrm{w} 协议

blocks.en: To evaluate whether the framework generalizes to vendor-by-protocol groups not represented during training, we performed two protocol hold-out experiments based on the T 1 ​ w T_{1}\mathrm{w} sequence used to define these groups in the main analysis. We trained one model exclusively on sessions from the Philips and Siemens MPRAGE groups, withholding the Philips Spoiled GRE group. We trained a second model exclusively on sessions from the Philips Spoiled GRE group, withholding both MPRAGE groups. Both protocol-restricted models used the same network architecture, loss weights, and optimization schedule as the pooled model (presented in the main paper) and differed only in the training data provided to them. We evaluated all models on the complete clinical test set ( n = 1,237 n=1{,}237 sessions). Table S8.1 summarizes the corresponding training subsets.
blocks.zh: 为了评价这个框架是否向在培训期间没有代表的逐个供应商团体概括,我们进行了两次协议搁置试验,这些试验基于在主要分析中用来界定这些团体的T 1 w T_{1}\mathrm{w}序列。 我们专门训练了飞利浦和西门子MPRAGE团体的模型 扣留了飞利浦被破坏的GRE团体 我们训练了第二个模式 专门从飞利浦破坏的GRE组, 扣留两个MPRAGE组。 两种协议限制的模型都采用了与集合模型相同的网络架构,减重,优化时间表(在主论文中介绍),仅在提供给它们的培训数据上存在差异. 我们在完整的临床测试集上评价了所有模型(n = 1,237 n = 1{,}237会). 表S8.1汇总了相应的培训子集。

blocks.en: Withholding a protocol during training substantially shifted the parameter estimates for the corresponding out-of-domain vendor-by-protocol groups, indicated by † in Table S8.2 . When applied to the unseen Philips Spoiled GRE group, the MPRAGE-only model produced a mean white-matter MPF of 0.126 0.126 , compared with approximately 0.18 0.18 in the two in-domain MPRAGE groups. White-matter T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} and T 2 f T_{2}^{\mathrm{f}} also shifted to markedly higher values. Accordingly, the between-group CV of white-matter MPF increased from 2.65 % 2.65\% for the pooled model to 19.71 % 19.71\% .
blocks.zh: 如表S8.2所示,在培训期间没有签订协议,大大改变了相应领域外供应商集团的参数估计数。 当应用于未见的飞利浦Spoiled GRE组时,只使用MPRAGE的型号生成了0.126 0.126的中白物质MPF,而两个域内MPRAGE组大约为0.18 0.18. White-matter T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} 和 T 2 f T_{2}^{\mathrm{f}} 也转移到明显更高的值. 因此,白物质MPF的组间CV从集合模型的2.65%2.65%增加到19.71% 19.71%。

blocks.en: Conversely, when applied to the unseen MPRAGE groups, the Spoiled-GRE-only model produced lower white-matter MPF values and markedly higher white-matter T 1 f T_{1}^{\mathrm{f}} and T 2 f T_{2}^{\mathrm{f}} values than in the in-domain Spoiled GRE group. Mean white-matter MPF decreased from 0.177 0.177 in the Spoiled GRE group to approximately 0.15 0.15 in both MPRAGE groups, increasing the between-group CV to 11.06 % 11.06\% .
blocks.zh: 相反,当应用到看不见的 MPRAGE 组时, Spoiled-GRE 唯一的模型产生了较低的白物质 MPF 值,以及显著高于域内 Spoiled GRE 组中的白物质 T 1 f T → 1 → mathrm{ f}} 和 T 2 f T_{2 → mathrm{ f}} 数值 。 平均白物质MPF从被破坏的GRE组的0.177 0.177下降到两个MPRAGE组的0.15 0.15左右,将CV组之间的比例提高到11.06%-11.06%。

blocks.en: Despite differences in scanner vendor, the MPRAGE-only model produced similar estimates for the Philips and Siemens MPRAGE groups. In contrast, both protocol-restricted models produced substantial parameter shifts when applied to the withheld sequence regime. These findings suggest that stable estimation requires the relevant acquisition protocols to be represented during training.
blocks.zh: 尽管在扫描器供应商方面存在差异,但只使用MPRAGE的模型对飞利浦和西门子MPRAGE集团得出了类似的估计。 与此相反,两个受协议限制的模型在适用于预留序列制度时产生了实质性参数变化。 这些调查结果表明,稳定的估算要求相关购置协议在培训期间得到体现。
